blocks.text: CLEANOUT FAQ
Cleanout Services in Pickering — Every-Era Questions, Reliable Answers

items.q: What cleanout services do you offer in Pickering?
a: We provide professional cleanout services for houses, apartments, condos, garages, basements, attics, storage units, offices, rental properties, estates, and commercial spaces. Whether you’re decluttering, moving, renovating, or preparing a property for sale, we’re here to help.

items.q: Can you remove old furniture, appliances, and household junk?
a: Yes. Our team removes sofas, mattresses, tables, appliances, electronics, office furniture, yard waste, renovation debris, and most non-hazardous junk. We do all the heavy lifting, loading, and hauling for you.

items.q: Do I need to be present during the cleanout?
a: Not necessarily. If you’ve provided access to the property and clear instructions about what should be removed, we can complete the cleanout while you’re away and keep you informed throughout the process.

items.q: How long does a cleanout usually take?
a: The timeframe depends on the size of the property and the amount of material to be removed. Most residential cleanouts are completed within a few hours, while larger estate or commercial cleanouts may take a full day.

items.q: What do you do with the items you remove?
a: Whenever possible, we donate reusable items, recycle eligible materials, and dispose of the remaining waste responsibly. Our goal is to provide an environmentally responsible cleanout service while helping reduce landfill waste in Pickering.
